judgment.notes: There are no M/E applications. N003's rational-line clause is instantiated with the chosen nonzero a∈J and each generator g_j∈J. Its unique-coordinate clause is used only for coefficients in J, namely r_i b. The prime guard H001 for R and its dependent definitions is a direct input.

S001 correctly deletes zero generators and uses J≠0 to retain a nonempty family. In S002 each q_j is nonzero by g_j≠0. Factor removal from nonzero integer numerators and denominators terminates: p≥2 and each division strictly reduces positive absolute value. The residual numerator and denominator are not divisible by p, so their quotient and reciprocal lie in R by its defining denominator condition. A finite nonempty list of integer exponents has an attained minimum by finite comparison/induction. In S003 the minimizing generator gives b=u_{j_0}^{-1}g_{j_0}∈J and b≠0. All other generators are R-multiples since their exponent differences are nonnegative. Thus both inclusions J=Rb hold. N003 supplies spanning and uniqueness; coefficients r_i b lie in J and their vanishing implies r_i=0 by complex field cancellation. The argument is independent of the constructed b once b≠0 and J=Rb, so proves the universal basis clause too. BG001 supplies the routine interval count; n>0 is already an input.

Both direct inputs have real roles: H001 gives p≥2 and p≠0 and discharges R's prime guard; N003 gives nonzero finite generation, rational proportionality, coordinate uniqueness/spanning and n>0. Some conjuncts of N003 (the tensor-space dimension assertions and equality of Jcoord_i) are unnecessary here, which does not make the input unused. F001 and F002 are proved in order. No PID, valuation, tensor, or abstract basis theorem is silently applied: the generator and spanning/independence are constructed in the prose. The sole recorded completion BG001 is elementary interval counting; no library facts are imported.

The factual uses trace to H001/N003, the guarded definitions, earlier F001/F002, module/field structure axioms, and elementary finite arithmetic/order/induction. In particular rational proportionality is explicitly present in N003, not inferred from an absent tensor theorem. The factorization used is actually derived by terminating removal of p factors; principal generation is actually derived from its finite minimum, not assumed from a localization theorem. The coordinate description used for the basis is an explicit N003 premise. BG001 completes only cardinality. No ancestor producer or external project input is used.

The inference's H001 and N003 match its two supplied conditional premises and use the same p,R,J,e,I,M_R,n. The chosen a and each g_j satisfy the nonzero/member conditions required by N003's rational-line clause. The coordinate argument uses N003's explicit unique-expression assertion, including the converse finite-sum inclusion, rather than any facts from its absent producer. N003's inside-V identification is retained. No extra original hypothesis is presumed.

Global occurrences are covered by parameters and D definitions, with H001 available for R,M_R,ι_R,J and Jcoord. From n>0 and n=λ+1, indices in I are nonnegative as required for e_i and finite interval counting. The nonzero a is chosen from N003; g is chosen only after F001. Within S002, j ranges over g, q_j is chosen by N003, and the generic q=A/B, factor counts s,t and residual integers A',B' are introduced locally in the factor-removal construction. F002 quantifies its coefficient, unit and exponent families, minimum and attaining index. S003 chooses compatible νexp,u,ν,j_0 simultaneously from that one existential fact, then defines the complex b; p≠0 permits all negative powers. Its membership and nonvanishing are proved, not granted by the declaration. The r_i in the zero relation are arbitrary R-coefficients bound by that argument. a,g remain in scope through S003; input-bound T is not used as a free local.

S003 proves existence of b∈J\{0} and both inclusions J=Rb. For any b satisfying those conditions, the input coordinate decomposition gives spanning by b e_i and uniqueness after cancellation of b, hence precisely an R-basis of the supplied inside-V M_R. No additional property of the specially constructed b is used for this universal clause. The index set is exactly I, with cardinality n by BG001; positivity n>0 is supplied by N003. Thus every clause of N004, including the universal 'any such b' and the identification under ι_R, is retained.
